purpose: Honest mining report: tried to find CHudResult::Update body in local_build_env/ur103clean/UnleashedRecompLib/ppc/ppc_recomp.*.cpp. Documents what worked, what didn't, and what the next concrete unblocking moves are.

what_was_attempted.result: zero matches. The Xbox 360 .xex is LZX-compressed; raw byte-grep cannot see strings until the .data section is decompressed. The 'strings' tool returned 670834 lines but none match the result-related keywords.
the file is a 66838-line address->stub dispatch table with no debug symbols. Just { 0x822C0000, sub_822C0000 } pairs. No way to match a sub_ to a class name.

what_was_attempted.approach: search patches/ for any CHudResult / HudResult wrapper
what_was_attempted.result: zero hits. UnleashedRecomp ships wrappers for CHudPause, CTitleStateMenu, CTitleStateIntro, CTitleStateWorldMap, CHudSonicStage -- but NOT for CHudResult. The retail Result.cpp logic doesn't need a host-side fix in UnleashedRecomp, so it has no wrapper.
what_was_attempted.verdict: no wrapper layer to use as an entry point

what_was_attempted.approach: look for a static .data section dump alongside the recomp output
what_was_attempted.result: no separate .data dump exists. XenonRecomp loads default_patched.xex at runtime via XenonUtils/image.cpp -- the data section is read in memory at startup, not emitted as a static C++ array. Strings resolve through a runtime base-pointer + offset, not via grep-able literals.
what_was_attempted.verdict: needs xex-side disassembly tool to extract strings

what_was_attempted.approach: scan ppc_recomp for distinctive callee combinations (a function that calls 6 setters in a row could be CHudResult driving result_num_1..6)
what_was_attempted.result: 264 ppc_recomp.*.cpp files, ~22000 functions, ~80MB total source. Without a known-good seed function (e.g. a confirmed counter-setter sub_ to anchor against), the callee-graph search is N^2 across all functions. Multi-day work for unclear payoff.
what_was_attempted.verdict: feasible but not high-leverage in this session

what_we_already_have_that_is_retail_vali: ResultsLineId 1:1 mapping to result_num_1..6 (from aspect_ratio_patches.cpp:664-705 — the 6 numeric counters in the asset)
BGM cue names (bgm_sys_result, bgm_sys_result_ng) — from install/hashes/game.cpp:8111-8114
ResultsRank values inferred from standard SU layout (D/C/B/A/S)
what_is_still_inferred_in_sgfx_results_s: secondsBetweenLines = 0.4f (line-reveal animation pacing) — pure guess, not retail-mined
Order of line reveals (rank first, then score, time, rings, special, total) — assumed standard Sonic Unleashed layout, but retail might reveal them differently
Acknowledged event triggers immediate transition to WorldMap — could be a fade-out + delay in retail
No 'skip to end' input handler modeled — retail might let the user press accept during tally to fast-forward

concrete_unblocking_paths_ranked_by_cost.what_user_does: Play UnleashedRecomp through to a stage clear (any continent works -- e.g. clear an Apotos or Mazuri Day act). The UI Lab JSONL emitter (Phase 315) will log every Game_PlaySound call and every state-machine update during the Results screen.
concrete_unblocking_paths_ranked_by_cost.what_we_extract: Real per-frame timing of line reveals, real BGM-mount timestamps, real cue sequence (does sys_actstg_result-stinger fire? Does the rank fanfare differ per rank?), real input handling.
concrete_unblocking_paths_ranked_by_cost.yield: retail-validated inner state machine; 80% of what a static decompile would give us

concrete_unblocking_paths_ranked_by_cost.path: Run XenonRecomp's xex-extraction tools to get a string-resolvable .data section dump
concrete_unblocking_paths_ranked_by_cost.what_user_does: Build XenonRecomp's XenonAnalyse tool with the analysis flag that emits string tables; run it against default_patched.xex.
concrete_unblocking_paths_ranked_by_cost.what_we_extract: Address->string map for the .rdata section. We could then grep ppc_recomp.*.cpp for the addresses being loaded as immediates and find every function that touches any 'ui_result*' string.

concrete_unblocking_paths_ranked_by_cost.what_we_extract: candidate CHudResult::Update bodies by finding functions that call 6 contiguous setter calls with similar offsets
concrete_unblocking_paths_ranked_by_cost.yield: uncertain; might match many false-positives without an anchor
